orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Emberkin "Pyre Drive" (thrust x1.5, hot), a hull mount (outward is up): outside, one big brass bell breathing a real flame (hard flame tongues over the mouth, 3-frame flicker) with two small pilot nozzles; a brass collar through the wall; inside, a brass furnace core with a flame window, three pressure gauges, a hatch and a power coupling. Damaged: the bell lip dented and a side pilot burning crooked, the gauges cracked, sparks at the coupling. Disabled: the flame out, the bell split and slumped, the furnace dark. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
